description: Redesign auth pages (signin, signup, auth layout) and onboarding page with glassmorphism styling, animated background orbs, and emerald accents.
steps: Rewrite app/(auth)/layout.tsx: Dark bg-gray-950 background. Add 2-3 animated gradient orbs (emerald/teal blurred circles with 'blob' animation at different delays, positioned absolute). Center content. Logo uses emerald gradient text (from-emerald-400 to-teal-400 bg-clip-text text-transparent). Remove all light mode classes.

Update app/(auth)/signin/page.tsx: The Card component already has glass styling from FEAT-001. Update text colors: h1 text-white, subtitle text-gray-400. Error box: bg-red-500/10 border border-red-500/30 text-red-400. Link text: text-emerald-400 hover:text-emerald-300. Remove all dark: prefixed classes (since dark is default now) and remove light mode classes. Keep all form logic and functionality intact.

Update app/(auth)/signup/page.tsx: Same approach as signin. Text colors: h1 text-white, subtitle text-gray-400. Error/validation styling: bg-red-500/10 border border-red-500/30 text-red-400. Link: text-emerald-400 hover:text-emerald-300. Remove light mode references. Keep all form validation logic and functionality intact.

Rewrite app/onboarding/page.tsx: Outer container bg-gray-950 with subtle animated orb in background. Main content wrapper uses glass card styling (bg-white/5 backdrop-blur-xl border-white/10 rounded-2xl p-8). Progress bar: bg-white/10 track with bg-gradient-to-r from-emerald-500 to-teal-500 fill. Step heading text-white. Selection buttons/chips: unselected = bg-white/5 border-white/10, selected = bg-emerald-500/20 border-emerald-500/50 text-emerald-300. Region list items same pattern. Navigation buttons use the updated Button component. Remove all light mode classes. Keep all business logic (step state, form submission, toggles) intact.
acceptance_criteria: Auth layout has dark background with animated gradient orbs
Auth layout logo uses emerald gradient text
Signin page uses glass card with emerald-accented links and buttons
Signup page matches signin styling approach
Onboarding has glass container with emerald gradient progress bar
Onboarding selection chips use emerald colors when selected
No light mode classes remain (no bg-gray-50, bg-white without opacity, text-gray-900 etc)
All form logic and API calls remain unchanged
npm run build succeeds without errors
verification: Run npm run build in /projects/sandbox/notherobrinesmplol and confirm exit code 0
